companyDescription: Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) for AI optical networks · POET Optical Interposer — chip-level integration of electronic + photonic devices for frontier AI datacenter interconnects
priceNote: Recovering from Marvell cancellation -50% crash · $400M investment closed May 2026 · PFIC class action overhang
summary: POET Technologies holds a genuinely differentiated photonic integration IP (Optical Interposer) that enables AI datacenters to push optical networking from the rack level to chip level — a massive TAM if they win. The $400M capital raise validates institutional belief in the platform. BUT: Marvell cancelled all purchase orders (Apr 2026) citing CFO confidentiality breach, triggering class action lawsuits and a -50% crash. Recovery thesis: new hyperscaler customer + Lumilens partnership execution. HIGH risk — position max 2% only. ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 70%+.

catalysts.name: New Hyperscaler Customer Announcement
catalysts.description: POET needs to replace Marvell with a direct hyperscaler (Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta) — any announcement would 3–5x the stock from current levels

catalysts.name: Lumilens Partnership Scale-up
catalysts.description: POET + Lumilens advancing wafer-level photonic integration for next-gen AI optical networks (announced May 2026) — first revenue recognition from this partnership

catalysts.name: $400M Capital Deployment
catalysts.description: Largest capital raise in POET history — institutional investor took $400M direct at $21/share. Capital to scale manufacturing and accelerate product leadership

risks: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Marvell cancelled ALL purchase orders — POET's primary revenue pipeline was eliminated overnight (Apr 2026)
Class action lawsuits (Gibbs Mura, Bernstein Liebhard, Johnson Fistel) — CFO confidentiality breach allegation; legal overhang suppresses valuation
PFIC (Passive Foreign Investment Company) tax status issue — Canadian entity filing creates US investor tax complexity
Pre-revenue stage — $1.4M TTM revenue vs $2.1B market cap; extremely speculative valuation
New customer acquisition timeline unknown — may take 12–18 months to validate new hyperscaler partnership
Massive warrant overhang — $400M raise included 19M warrants; dilution if/when exercised

estimateDates.note: Revenue near zero; watch cash burn rate and customer pipeline update
The binary catalyst — no date set

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Pre-revenue semiconductor IP company is highly rate-sensitive in terms of valuation multiples. Higher rates = lower tolerance for zero-revenue companies.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Wafer-level photonic manufacturing has high R&D and materials costs — inflation compresses cash runway. $400M raise provides buffer.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI optical interconnect TAM is $50B+ by 2028 — massive secular tailwind if POET's Optical Interposer standard gets adopted. But near-term: class actions + no customer = valuation compression.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — primarily company-specific risk from Marvell cancellation and class actions. Macro is secondary to customer pipeline execution.
